A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same FLARE research and provide readable main text, equations, seven tables, six figures and Appendices A–B. Text comparison and visual inspection reveal no material gaps limiting comparison.

before.justification: v4 reports original pose-estimation, reconstruction and novel-view synthesis results in Section 4, together with ablations and additional experiments in Appendix B.

after.justification: v5 retains these original empirical results, including the main benchmark comparisons, component ablations and appendix experiments.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.4 retain the same pose predictor, camera-centric geometry estimator, global geometry projector, Gaussian appearance head, pose augmentation and training losses.

E1.justification: The eight training datasets and evaluation coverage are unchanged, including RealEstate10K, DL3DV, ETH3D, DTU, TUM RGBD and BlendedMVS ablations. Appendix B retains the same variable-view and dense-reconstruction scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership matches within every reported comparison. For example, Table 2 retains DUSt3R, MASt3R and Spann3R; Tables 1, 3, 4 and 7 also retain their respective baseline sets.

E3.justification: Training settings, metrics, splits and testing procedures match. These include five-view RealEstate10K pose evaluation, two-view RealEstate10K synthesis, DL3DV sampling and Appendix B's varying-source-view experiment with two fixed query views.

E4.justification: Table 5 retains the same component and rendering-loss ablations. Appendix B retains the MVSplat input-view analysis, FLARE view-count sensitivity study and DTU qualitative examples, with unchanged questions and evidence.

E5.justification: Both versions use the same point-estimate reporting. Neither reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests for the experimental results.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–7 and the plotted and qualitative findings match. For example, FLARE's RealEstate10K pose AUC remains 79.9 in Table 1, and its dense-DTU overall score remains 1.321 in Table 7.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and equations (1)–(12), including geometry projection, rendering normalization and losses, are unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations, theorems or proofs are added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and Discussion retain the same claims about cascaded pose-guided reconstruction, two-stage geometry learning, sparse uncalibrated inputs, state-of-the-art performance and inference below 0.5 seconds.

C2.justification: The explanations of pose priors, joint learning and rendering-loss trade-offs remain unchanged. Appendix B preserves the qualifications about limited two-view precision, diminishing gains from additional views and the method's lack of specialization for dense reconstruction.

D1.justification: Architecture specifications, optimizer settings, 64-A800 training for 200 epochs, approximate training time, Appendix A preprocessing and variable-view token details are unchanged. Both retain the same project/code access pointer.

R1.justification: Section 2's research positioning and all 101 cited reference entries are unchanged. Bibliography reflow does not add or remove any cited work.

P1.justification: v5 changes the first author's printed name from 'Shangzhan Zhang' to 'Shangzan Zhang', updates the version/date stamp and removes the funding-support sentence from Acknowledgements. Scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Removing the funding sentence shifts bibliography text across columns and pages 9–13. All six figures and seven tables retain their content, structure and placement; there is no substantive visual redesign.

improvement.justification: The methods, empirical support, interpretations and reproducibility details are unchanged, including the appendices. The author-name edit, removed funding attribution and minor bibliography reflow do not materially change the paper's clarity or evidential strength, yielding no meaningful overall quality difference.
